sentences.en: People were delighted at the safe return of the astronauts.
sentences.zh: 人们很高兴宇航员安全返回。

sentences.en: To our great relief, she returned home safe and sound.
sentences.zh: 令我们非常欣慰的是，她平安无事地回到了家。

sentences.en: The width of the road is insufficient for safe driving.
sentences.zh: 这条道路宽度不足，不适合安全驾驶。

senses.zh: 安全的；无危险的；可靠的；稳妥的
